title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description: Given a string `s`, return the longest palindromic substring in `s`. If multiple exist, return the one that appears first.

sample_tests.explanation: bab or aba is valid. First is bab.

hints: A palindrome mirrors around its center.
Expand around each index: treat index i as center for odd lengths, (i, i+1) for even lengths.
Keep track of the longest palindrome substring found.

reference_solution:
import sys
s = sys.stdin.read().rstrip('\r\n')
if not s:
    print('')
    sys.exit(0)
def expand(l, r):
    while l >= 0 and r < len(s) and s[l] == s[r]:
        l -= 1; r += 1
    return s[l+1:r]
best = ''
for i in range(len(s)):
    p1 = expand(i, i)
    p2 = expand(i, i + 1)
    if len(p1) > len(best): best = p1
    if len(p2) > len(best): best = p2
print(best)
